SELECT
  e.event,
  e.severity,
  e.status,
  e.source,
  e.component,
  e.message,
  e.requires_attention,
  e.created_at,
  e.timestamp,
  e.details
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    event,
    severity,
    status,
    source,
    component,
    message,
    requires_attention,
    created_at,
    timestamp,
    details
  FROM hestia_events
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1000
) e ON TRUE;

SELECT
  e.event,
  e.severity,
  e.status,
  e.source,
  e.component,
  e.message,
  e.requires_attention,
  e.created_at,
  e.timestamp,
  e.details
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    event,
    severity,
    status,
    source,
    component,
    message,
    requires_attention,
    created_at,
    timestamp,
    details
  FROM hestia_events
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1000
) e ON TRUE;

SELECT
  h.id,
  h.timestamp,
  h.mount,
  h.total_bytes,
  h.used_bytes,
  h.free_bytes,
  h.used_percent,
  h.created_at
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    id,
    timestamp,
    mount,
    total_bytes,
    used_bytes,
    free_bytes,
    used_percent,
    created_at
  FROM omeab_capacity_history
  WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ORDER BY timestamp ASC
) h ON TRUE;
